title: Full Stack Developer - NestJS (Node.js)
description:
Full Stack Developer - NestJS (Node.js) Job Opening at Hexaphor Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Hexaphor Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is hiring a Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in NestJS (Node.js) to work on scalable, system-designed, production-grade applications .
This opportunity is ideal for developers experienced in backend architecture, API design, and full stack development who want to work on high-impact technology projects.

Hexaphor Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is expanding its engineering team and looking for a skilled and experienced Full Stack Developer - NestJS (Node.js) to join our high-performance development team. If you have hands-on experience building production-grade applications , contributing to system design and scalable architectures , we would like to hear from you. 
 Key Responsibilities Backend Development & System Design (NestJS) Design and develop scalable backend systems using NestJS (Node.js) Participate in system design, architecture planning, and technical decisions Build secure, well-structured RESTful APIs Implement authentication, authorization, and role-based access control Frontend Development Develop and integrate frontend interfaces using React / Next.js / Angular Build reusable, maintainable UI components following modern standards Database & Performance Optimization Design and optimize SQL / NoSQL database schemas Ensure application performance, scalability, security, and reliability Collaboration & Code Quality Work closely with Product, UI/UX, QA, and DevOps teams Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code using TypeScript Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and technical documentation Support deployment, monitoring, and production readiness 

 Required Skills Strong hands-on experience with NestJS (Node.js) Proficiency in TypeScript Full Stack development experience (Backend + Frontend) Solid understanding of system design and scalable architecture Experience with PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB Frontend experience with React / Next.js / Angular Strong understanding of API integration and security best practices 

 Preferred Qualifications Experience in Healthcare / HMS / HealthTech platforms Knowledge of data privacy, security, and compliance Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP) Exposure to microservices architecture and performance optimization Familiarity with healthcare standards ( FHIR / HL7 - optional ) 

 Interested candidates can apply by submitting their resume through our official website or contacting our HR team. 

 Disclaimer: This job posting and Location has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

Key Skills: ci/cd pipelines,api integration,fhir,cloud platforms,backend development,backend architecture,code quality,docker
